pack.provenance: Researched on 2026-09-28 from Knott's press releases (via reprints; Knott's 2024 and 2025 pages are no longer online), the official 2026 event page, the official 2025 map, reputable theme-park press and YouTube walkthroughs. Assembled with an AI research assistant for Haunt Ranker; every record cites its sources.
pack.notes: Three seasons: 2024, 2025 and 2026. A maze that ran in several of these seasons is one record filed under its first, with the later seasons as appearances. Debut years come from Knott's own "new" billing, or from two independent sources that agree. Scare zone debut years are left unset because only Wikipedia gives them. Building-level maze locations come from event maps and fan wikis. Special experiences (ride overlays, exhibits, the opening ceremony) are archive and wiki content, not ranked. Shows are deliberately not included in this pack. The Gauntlet is two records: the 2024 zone and the reimagined version billed from 2025. Not confirmed, so left out: Calico Candy Mine in 2025 and 2026, and Coasters in the Dark.

experiences.name: Eight Fingers Nine: The Boogeyman
experiences.location: Backstage building beside GhostRider, in the space formerly used by Dark Entities
experiences.summary: A storybook-style maze set in a colonial township terrorised at night by a finger-eating boogeyman.

wiki.overview: A dark fairy tale told as a walk-through storybook. It is set in an 18th-century colonial township where an inhuman creature with a taste for fingers comes out after dark.
wiki.story: Official copy: when night falls, the monster Eight Fingers Nine emerges looking for fresh meat. His bite brings on sleep paralysis, holding his victim still while he slowly eats their flesh. In designer Gus Krueger's backstory, a boy from the town of Aliston was tied to a tree by his tormentors and left to starve for eight days and nine nights. The Green Spirit of the Wood freed him, and his hatred, joined with dark forces of the forest, turned him into the boogeyman who preys on the townsfolk who wronged him.
wiki.experience: Scenes include a forest, an orphanage and The Miller Shop, an oddities shop filled with references to designer Daniel Miller's past mazes. The design draws on Grimm-style storybooks and classic dark rides. The official map calls it "a living fairy tale".
wiki.development: New for 2024, designed by Gus Krueger as an original character created for Knott's rather than an adaptation of an existing boogeyman legend. It returned in 2025 and 2026. A 2025 review observed that the Eight Fingers Nine character appears in more scenes than before; Knott's announced no changes. Official copy says 18th century; MiceChat's designer feature says 17th century.

experiences.name: Widows
experiences.summary: A nursing home overrun by demonic black widow spiders that possess its elderly residents.

wiki.overview: Set in a web-choked convalescent home where black widow spiders have taken over the bodies of the residents. The title plays on both bereavement and the spider.
wiki.story: Official copy: the widows crawl out of silken tunnels to possess the frail bodies of the residents, looking for a mate so they can hatch a clutch of eggs before sunrise. According to designer Daniel Miller, Gertrude, a voodoo priestess carried over from an earlier Scary Farm maze, opened a portal to the spider goddess Arachne, and spiders rose from underground to attack the residents of Sunset Rise Nursing Home.
wiki.experience: The facade is a decaying pink Victorian mansion with giant spiders and green fog seeping from beneath the house. Inside, heavy webbing brushes past guests and performers play possessed seniors. Later scenes include a venom hall, a birthing hall and a temple ending with the spider queen.
wiki.development: New for 2024, designed by Daniel Miller. It returned in 2025, when a review noted some set pieces had been rearranged, and again in 2026. One 2024 lineup article billed it in the singular as "Widow"; the press release and other sources use "Widows".

experiences.name: Room 13
experiences.summary: A Prohibition-era murder mystery that leads from a speakeasy into a hotel.

wiki.overview: A Prohibition-era mystery connecting a string of murders at The Blind Tiger speakeasy to the Argive Hotel.
wiki.story: Official copy: violent murders interrupt the revelry at The Blind Tiger, a speakeasy on Memory Lane. They centre on The Devil's Elixir, a dangerously addictive green cocktail tied to the mayhem at the Argive Hotel.
wiki.experience: Features mirrors, elevator effects and distinctive green lighting, and leans on the cocktail-and-murder storyline more than on jump scares.
wiki.development: Debuted in 2023 and returned in 2024, 2025 and 2026. It shares The Blind Tiger backstory with The Gore-ing '20s scare zone. No changes were documented for 2025 or 2026.

related.notes: Both tell the story of The Blind Tiger speakeasy.

experiences.name: Cinema Slasher
experiences.summary: Guests at the Midnight Theater step through the screen into a trilogy of slasher films.

wiki.overview: An original homage to slasher films. Guests enter the Midnight Theater, pass through the silver screen and become characters trying to survive the Slasher.
wiki.experience: Plays as a triple feature: a fraternity slasher, a camp killer and a torture dungeon. A giant popcorn-bucket character was added in 2024.
wiki.development: Debuted in 2023 and returned in 2024, 2025 and 2026. One 2025 guide listed it as new, which contradicts Knott's press release naming it among the returning mazes. Sometimes misspelled "Cinema Slashers".

experiences.name: The Chilling Chambers
experiences.location: Camp Snoopy entrance, by the front gates
experiences.summary: A tribute maze that brings back themes and monsters from Scary Farm's own history.

wiki.overview: A retrospective of Knott's Scary Farm itself, created for the event's 50th anniversary as a tribute to its first maze and the mazes that followed.
wiki.story: Guests enter a foreboding cathedral and meet classic themes from Scary Farm's past. In 2025 Knott's billed the Crimson Lord as the guide.
wiki.experience: A "greatest hits" format with crypts and coffins labelled with the names of retired mazes. New gravestones were added in 2025 for Wax Works and Bloodline 1842, and in 2026 for Mesmer.
wiki.development: Debuted in 2023. 2026 was announced as its final year. Sources disagree on whether The Keeper, a host character inspired by Larry Vincent, appeared in 2024.

media.licenseNotes: Official art from Knott's 2026 event page. Six Flags reserves all rights; its Terms of Use allow limited display for personal, noncommercial purposes only. Not for redistribution; an offline copy may be kept for personal use. The Chilling Chambers, as shown in 2026.

experiences.name: The Grimoire
experiences.summary: An ancient spellbook whose stories turn guests' nightmares into reality.

wiki.overview: Built around an ancient spellbook whose dark stories exist to make guests' worst nightmares real. Guests have to escape the book's demonic creatures.
wiki.experience: The story moves across eras, including camp children unleashing a curse, a 1950s setting and World War I trenches, with black-and-white scene effects. The pre-show video used in earlier years was not shown in 2024.
wiki.development: Debuted in 2022. Knott's announced 2025 as its final year, and its space became home to Unearthed in 2026.

experiences.name: Mesmer: Sideshow of the Mind
experiences.location: Boardwalk, in a tent behind Xcelerator
experiences.summary: A hypnotist's sideshow that promises to cure guests' phobias and preys on them instead.

wiki.overview: A sideshow tent run by the hypnotist Professor Mesmer, who offers to cure fears such as snakes, spiders, darkness and claustrophobia.
wiki.story: Official copy: guests surrender to Mesmer's hypnosis, and his sideshow feeds on their hidden fears.
wiki.experience: A narrated, story-driven circus sideshow with optical illusions. New video was added to the entrance hallway in 2025.
wiki.development: Debuted in 2021. Knott's announced 2025 as its final year, and Inked took over its site in 2026. Mesmer the character moved into the CarnEVIL scare zone in 2026.

media.attribution: Presumed Knott's Berry Farm (rehosted by Theme Park Duo)
media.licenseNotes: A copy on a third-party site with no credit or licence stated. Mesmer's 2023 media art. Redistribution unclear; an offline copy may be kept for personal use.

experiences.name: Wax Works
experiences.summary: A twisted wax museum where victims are dipped in scalding wax.

wiki.overview: Set in an abandoned wax museum where Dr. Augustus Scratch turns his victims into works of art by dipping them into a cauldron of scorching wax.
wiki.experience: Scenes include a fire-damaged wax museum and a dungeon workshop.
wiki.development: Debuted in 2019 in the space formerly used by the Trick or Treat maze. Its 2024 final year was announced at Midsummer Scream 2024 and confirmed in Knott's press release.

experiences.name: Bloodline 1842
experiences.summary: Vampire hunters battle the King of the Valhymphri in the war-torn city of Valdonia.

wiki.overview: Guests join the fight in the war-torn city of Valdonia against the King of the Valhymphri and his vampires.
wiki.experience: It opened as an interactive shooting maze. Reviewers report it ran as a standard walk-through in 2024.
wiki.development: Debuted in 2022. Knott's press release named 2024 as its final year.

experiences.name: Origins: The Curse of Calico
experiences.summary: The origin of Scary Farm's Green Witch, told through Sarah Marshall's trial for witchcraft in Calico.

wiki.overview: Knott's own Ghost Town lore: the paranormal forces that plague the town of Calico, and how they began.
wiki.story: Official copy: Sarah Marshall is tried for witchcraft as the town is overrun by the paranormal. Convicted and sentenced to hang, she curses the townsfolk and becomes the Green Witch, who turns them into creatures that hunt the living.
wiki.experience: Includes a bank-heist scene and a creature called the Catawampus.
wiki.development: Debuted in 2019. 2026 was announced as its final year. The Green Witch is also part of the Timber Mountain Log Ride: Halloween Hootenanny overlay.

characters.name: Sarah Marshall
characters.description: Accused of witchcraft; becomes the Green Witch.

experiences.name: Mary – The Haunting of Worth Home
experiences.summary: Knott's own take on the Bloody Mary legend, set in the Worth family's once-perfect home.

wiki.overview: An original maze built around Knott's version of the Bloody Mary legend, inside the decaying Worth family home.
wiki.story: Official copy: after Mary Worth's family died suddenly, jealous townsfolk murdered her and buried her alive. She returns from the grave searching for her family, and she and her creatures take revenge on anyone who enters her home. At the announcement, the designers said the story spans from Elizabethan times to the present, drawing guests from the present day into Mary's past.
wiki.experience: Built around mirror effects, with large puppet monsters and realistic rooms including a garage and a greenhouse. Much of it is set in a halfway house overrun by demons from the mirror.
wiki.development: New for 2025, created by Jon Asperin, and returned in 2026. The official map styles the name "Mary: Haunting of Worth Home".

experiences.name: The Zoo
experiences.summary: An abandoned zoo turned military laboratory, where animal-human hybrids have turned on their makers.

wiki.overview: A military installation has moved into an abandoned zoo and is splicing soldiers with animal DNA to create super soldiers.
wiki.story: Official copy: guests arrive as new recruits and discover that the hybrid creatures have turned on their creators and are planning something that will change everything.
wiki.experience: Scenes are grouped by animal, such as an aviary and an aquarium, with interactive buttons at the enclosures. Every night at 11 p.m. the lights go out and guests go through by flashlight, so the maze runs in lights-on and lights-out versions.
wiki.development: New for 2025, designed by Daniel Miller, and returned in 2026.

experiences.name: Inked
experiences.location: Boardwalk, near Xcelerator, on the former Mesmer site
experiences.summary: A 1930s-cartoon horror maze in which a washed-up animator's creations come to life.

wiki.overview: Styled after golden-age 1930s cartoons, mixing mascot horror with multimedia. It begins in an animation studio and moves into the world of the studio's best-known cartoon.
wiki.story: Official copy: Mortimer Morbid, a washed-up 1930s cartoonist and former head of Morbid Studios, discovers that when blood becomes ink, imagination becomes reality. He brings his murderous cartoon characters to life for one last Halloween special, and they drag guests into their world.
wiki.experience: Opens with a pre-show video and uses puppets, mascot costumes, animatronics, projected 2D figures and rear-projected inflatable walls in small, tight rooms.
wiki.development: New for 2026, designed by Daniel Miller.

media.attribution: Knott's Berry Farm / Six Flags Entertainment Corp.
media.licenseNotes: Official art from Knott's 2026 event page. Six Flags reserves all rights; its Terms of Use allow limited display for personal, noncommercial purposes only. Not for redistribution; an offline copy may be kept for personal use. Inked.

experiences.name: Unearthed
experiences.location: Ghost Town, by the Mystery Lodge, in the former The Grimoire space
experiences.summary: A search-and-rescue team answers a distress call from an excavation site where something ancient has woken.

wiki.overview: A mummy-themed archaeological horror maze set at a ransacked excavation site, built with vertical sets, crevices, ancient religious imagery and animal-human hybrid figures.
wiki.story: Official copy: guests are a search-and-rescue team responding to a distress signal from an excavation. The discovery of ancient tablets has awoken a malevolent force from a forgotten age.
wiki.experience: Glowing hieroglyphics, levers and pressure plates, large monster encounters and a portal effect with mummies.
wiki.development: New for 2026, designed by Jon Asperin.

experiences.name: Ghost Town Streets
experiences.location: Ghost Town (Calico): the main street, graveyard, saloon and Bird Cage area
experiences.summary: Half-human, half-animal creatures roam the fog-filled streets of Calico.

wiki.overview: Billed by Knott's as the original scare zone "that started it all". Bands of half-human, half-animal monsters stalk Calico's foggy alleys.
wiki.experience: Home of the Sliders, performers who slide out of the fog. A 2025 review noted new creatures, including a bat character.

experiences.name: The Gore-ing '20s
experiences.location: Charleston Circle, by the Walter Knott Theater
experiences.summary: Cursed revellers from a 1920s speakeasy, with gangsters running illegal hooch.

wiki.overview: The revellers of The Blind Tiger, a secret speakeasy on Memory Lane, danced into oblivion when their decadence brought a deadly curse down on them. Gangsters, ghostly party guests and otherworldly musicians fill the area.
wiki.experience: Performers appear on the Walter Knott Theater balcony, including a live band and dancers.
wiki.development: Shares The Blind Tiger backstory with the Room 13 maze. Spelled variously "Gore-ing 20's", "Gore-ing 20s" and "GORE-ing 20s".

experiences.name: CarnEVIL
experiences.summary: Deviant clowns and circus freaks take over the Boardwalk midway.

wiki.overview: Clowns and sideshow freaks roam the Boardwalk's midway.
wiki.experience: A 2025 review noted refreshed costumes, including clowns in hockey and baseball jerseys and stunt-pilot characters.
wiki.development: Reimagined for 2026: Mesmer, the hypnotist from the maze retired after 2025, now runs the circus, and the sideshow has become the main event, with a large stage near Charleston Circle. MiceChat describes the change as mostly a redressing and repositioning of the classic zone. Styled "CARNEVIL", "CarnEVIL" or "CarnEvil".

related.notes: From 2026 Mesmer, from the retired maze, runs the circus.

experiences.name: Forsaken Lake
experiences.location: Around the lake beneath Silver Bullet, between Ghost Town and Fiesta Village
experiences.summary: Gothic creatures rise from a receded lake to drag victims to watery graves.

wiki.overview: The lake beneath Silver Bullet recedes to reveal crypts and gothic creatures rising from the dark water.
wiki.experience: A funeral procession travels to the spirit world each night at times listed in the park app.

experiences.name: The Gauntlet
experiences.summary: A medieval realm invades Camp Snoopy.

wiki.overview: The King and Queen of a medieval realm lead jesters, barbarians, wizards and lawless peasants through Camp Snoopy.
wiki.experience: Includes a nightly performance by the Sliders.
wiki.development: Returned in 2023 after a long hiatus. Knott's billed a reimagined version for 2025, which is recorded separately.

experiences.name: The Gauntlet
experiences.summary: A reimagined version of the medieval invasion of Camp Snoopy.

wiki.overview: The King and Queen of the realm, with jesters, barbarians, wizards and lawless peasants, invade Camp Snoopy again.
wiki.experience: Includes a nightly performance by the Sliders.
wiki.development: The official 2025 map bills it as "a reimagined version of the fan favorite", in which classic characters invade Camp Snoopy "with a new, surprising twist". Sources don't describe exactly what changed. It returned in 2026.

experiences.name: Timber Mountain Log Ride: Halloween Hootenanny
experiences.location: Timber Mountain Log Ride, Ghost Town
experiences.summary: Ride overlay: the log ride filled with Halloween monsters, some scary and some silly.

wiki.overview: A seasonal overlay of the Timber Mountain Log Ride, populated with Halloween monsters, aliens and creatures.
wiki.experience: Riders pass the Calico Coffin Creeper Band and the Green Witch before splashing down "Skull Mountain". Includes an alien-abduction scene.

experiences.name: Calico Candy Mine
experiences.summary: Ride overlay: the Pink Fairy turns the Calico Mine into a rock-candy mountain, with a darker twist at night.

wiki.overview: A seasonal overlay of the Calico Mine Ride. The night-time Scary Farm version is darker than the daytime version.
wiki.development: Documented for 2024. Whether it ran at Scary Farm in 2025 or 2026 could not be confirmed.

experiences.name: Yours Cruelly, Elvira EXXperience
experiences.summary: A self-guided exhibit looking back on Elvira's 20 seasons at Knott's Scary Farm.

wiki.overview: A walk-through retrospective of Cassandra Peterson's Elvira shows at Knott's Scary Farm, not a live show.
wiki.experience: Video highlights and behind-the-scenes footage, costumes, the Macabre Mobile (a customised 1958 Thunderbird), the red couch, the "Bone Phone" and other memorabilia. Cassandra Peterson appeared for signings and a Q&A on September 19 and October 18 and 20, 2024.
wiki.development: New for 2024. Styled "EXXperience" in the press release and "XXperience" or "Xxperience" elsewhere.

experiences.name: Into the Fog: A Scary Farm Tribute Art Show
experiences.summary: An exhibition and sale of original artwork celebrating Scary Farm's history.

wiki.overview: Original artwork inspired by Knott's Scary Farm's history, shown and sold during the event.

experiences.name: Legacy Haunt Store & Museum
experiences.summary: A haunt shop with a museum of exhibits from Scary Farm's past.

wiki.overview: A themed shop selling exclusive Scary Farm merchandise, with a museum display of historic exhibits from the event's past.

experiences.name: Scaremony
experiences.location: From Ghost Town Streets to Calico Park
experiences.summary: The opening ceremony that starts each night, ending with Sarah Marshall becoming the Green Witch.

wiki.overview: Begins about 15 minutes before the event opens and moves from Ghost Town Streets to Calico Park. The Lawman and the Hangman appear, and Sarah Marshall transforms into the Green Witch.
wiki.development: Documented for 2026 only in this pack.
